name: Joseph Martassek — parents named on an 1853 baptism, Krásno nad Kysucou, Slovakia
researcher_question: Who were the parents of Joseph Martassek of Krásno nad Kysucou, Slovakia, husband of Maria Szuchony and father of children baptised there between 1878 and 1893?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 9, hint-samples.csv row 250, flags adds_father/adds_mother, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-10-23 as a FALSE MATCH: the hint, an 1853 Krásno nad Kysucou Catholic baptism of Josephus Martassek naming parents Joannes Martassek and Maria Tizsinyák, concerns an infant who died aged five months on 9 October 1853 (Karásznó death register No. 119, ark:/61903/1:1:6N98-SCLC), so he cannot be the subject, who married Maria Szuchony and had children baptised at Krásno 1878-1893. Findings are an avoid guard on those parents plus a required documented rejection. CSV country Czechoslovakia; the record is in present-day Slovakia, tagged SK.
